Package io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe

Class Dataframe.Collector<T>

java.lang.Object
io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe.Dataframe.Collector<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the generic type of input elements to be processed by the collector for each column.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Collector<T,List<Map<String,Double>>,Dataframe>
Enclosing class:
Dataframe
public static class Dataframe.Collector<T> extends Object implements Collector<T,List<Map<String,Double>>,Dataframe>
Collector to transform a stream of objects into a Dataframe. The collector uses user-defined mapping functions to derive numeric values for columns from the elements in the stream.
For example,
collector.addColumn("age", Person::getAge);
collector.addColumn("weight", Person::getWeight);
will result in a dataframe with two columns age and weight.
